changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Rename the client login reference and its login record without changing stored values.
changeSet.sql: DO $$ DECLARE constraint_name text; BEGIN -- PostgreSQL 18 also names NOT NULL constraints; earlier versions have no such rows. FOR constraint_name IN SELECT conname FROM pg_constraint WHERE conrelid = 'web_client_login'::regclass AND contype = 'n' LOOP EXECUTE format('ALTER TABLE web_client_login RENAME CONSTRAINT %I TO %I', constraint_name, replace(replace(replace(constraint_name, 'web_user_session', 'web_client_login'), 'user_session_id', 'client_login_ref'), 'session_status', 'login_status')); END LOOP; END $$;
